name: GarageStack
description: GarageStack is an open-source vehicle monitoring dashboard for MG / SAIC electric and plug-in hybrid vehicles. It connects to the MG iSmart cloud via the SAIC MQTT Gateway and stores all data locally in an embedded PostgreSQL database. Features include a live dashboard, charging and efficiency statistics, trip history with heatmap visualisation, and Web Push notifications. Everything runs in a single container -- no external database or MQTT broker required.

paths.name: Data Directory
paths.description: Persistent storage for the PostgreSQL database, MQTT data, application logs, and ASP.NET Data Protection keys. Back this up regularly.

ports.name: Web UI Port
ports.description: Host port for the GarageStack web interface. Open this in your browser.

ports.name: MQTT Port
ports.description: Host port for the internal Mosquitto MQTT broker. Only expose if you need direct MQTT access from other devices.

variables.name: MG iSmart Email
variables.description: Your MG iSmart account email address. Must be the vehicle OWNER account -- shared or secondary accounts lack the write permissions needed to register alarm switches and will result in API error 1100003. Use a separate account on the MG phone app to avoid session conflicts.

variables.name: MG Region
variables.description: Region your vehicle is registered in: eu (Europe), cn (China), or row (Rest of World).

variables.name: Database Password
variables.description: Password for the embedded PostgreSQL database. Set a strong random value -- you will not need to enter this again. Generate one with: openssl rand -base64 24

variables.name: JWT Secret
variables.description: Secret used to sign login tokens. Must be at least 32 characters. Generate with: openssl rand -base64 32

variables.name: App URL
variables.description: The exact URL you use to open GarageStack in your browser, e.g. http://192.168.1.100:8080. Must match exactly -- wrong value causes login to fail.

variables.name: VAPID Public Key
variables.description: VAPID public key for Web Push notifications. Leave empty to disable push notifications (the rest of the app works fine without them). Generate a key pair with: npx web-push generate-vapid-keys

variables.name: VAPID Private Key
variables.description: VAPID private key for Web Push notifications. Keep this secret.

variables.name: Database Name
variables.description: PostgreSQL database name. Only change this if you know what you are doing.

variables.name: Database User
variables.description: PostgreSQL database user. Only change this if you know what you are doing.
